title.en-US: Civil Legal Capacity of a Natural Person

prompt.zh-CN: 自然人的民事权利能力何时取得？何时终止？
prompt.en-US: When does a natural person acquire civil legal capacity, and when does it end?

answer: 出生时取得，死亡时终止

reveal.zh-CN: 答案是出生时取得，死亡时终止。
reveal.en-US: The answer is that it begins at birth and ends at death.

prompt.en-US: Which of the following are legal persons?

reveal.zh-CN: 答案是 B 和 C。自然人不是法人，校内机构通常也不当然具有独立法人资格。
reveal.en-US: The answers are B and C. An individual person is not a legal person, and an internal university unit normally does not automatically have separate legal-person status.
